title: Talorys – A self-hosted personal AI agent on Cloudflare's free tier
summary: Talorys is a self-hosted personal AI agent designed to run entirely on Cloudflare's free tier, leveraging Workers, D1, and other serverless primitives. The GitHub project drew significant Hacker News attention (305 points, 141 comments), highlighting interest in low-cost, privacy-preserving agent deployments that avoid paid API infrastructure.
